en: Black‑and‑white multi-view postcard divided into four panels showing a small rural European village. The views include an elevated panorama of the village and surrounding fields, a church with a tower and clock, a village square with a pond and ducks bordered by traditional houses, and another wide view over the clustered rooftops. The captions in German read "Zadel", "Kirche", "Dorfplatz", and "Totalansicht".
